One side may carry a defect that its mirror counterpart does not have. The candidate regions below are normalized [x1, y1, x2, y2] in [0, 1] (origin top-left). (B) [0.2801, 0.7801, 0.4601, 0.9601]
(C) [0.5399, 0.7801, 0.7199, 0.9601]
(D) The two halves match; no defect in any of the above regions.

Answer with only the correct option letter.
